name: Box
material_impl: None. Plain polymorphic element; no glass at all despite living in a glass library. Story supplies all visual content.
motion: Applies 'motion-safe:transition-all' to every Box by default (respectMotionPreference=true), i.e. transition-all on arbitrary layout nodes; does not consult MotionPreferenceContext (Box.tsx:61-62).
a11y: Passes role/aria-label; auto-generates an id when aria-label is present (pointless). No semantics of its own, which is correct for a primitive.
api: forwardRef + 'as' (keyof JSX.IntrinsicElements only, not components). Name collides with a second, different 'Box' exported from GlassBox.tsx (system-props Box with displayName 'GlassBoxBase'); root exports this one, layout/index exports this one as Box and GlassBox's BoxProps as GlassBoxProps. Imports ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast unused.
ssr: 'use client' on a pure presentational primitive (unnecessary, blocks RSC usage). No window access.
fake_complexity: None, but 'respectMotionPreference' prop is misleading: it only toggles a Tailwind class.
target: Single layout primitive set: Box (polymorphic, asChild via primitives/slot) merged with GlassBox system-props variant
justification: Box is a 30-line div wrapper whose only behavior is adding transition-all to every node, which is a perf and visual-jank liability, and it shares its name with a second incompatible Box in GlassBox.tsx. Keep one polymorphic primitive (as/asChild, no default transitions, no 'use client'), and fold GlassBox's glass variant into it as a prop or a separate Surface component.

name: GlassBox
material_impl: Shared primitive: OptimizedGlass (intent neutral, intensity medium, depth 2, border subtle) when glass=true (GlassBox defaults glass=true, elevation level2, radius 8). Non-glass path is a MUI-style system-props box.
motion: animation='none'; no motion. Commented-out motion code left in (GlassBox.tsx:399-400).
a11y: No semantics; onClick on a div with no role/keyboard handling (GlassBox.tsx:168, 385). Imports ContrastGuard unused.
api: MUI-clone system props (p/pt/m/mx, bgcolor, flexDirection) with an 8px unit; numeric spacing is mapped to Tailwind classes ('p-3', 'p-6', 'p-[40px]') via spacingToTailwind (GlassBox.tsx:179-195) - arbitrary-value and many plain Tailwind classes are not in the shipped dist/styles/index.css, so spacing silently does nothing for consumers who do not scan the library with their own Tailwind. Also rounds 5->'6', 7->'8' (lossy). 'component' prop is ignored when glass=true (always renders OptimizedGlass div). Elevation accepts both 0-5 and 'level1-4' strings. BoxProps does not extend HTMLAttributes, so aria-*/data-* are untyped.
target: GlassSurface / OptimizedGlass primitive (glass) + single Box primitive (layout)
justification: GlassBox is a thin preset over OptimizedGlass bolted onto a second MUI-style system-props Box whose spacing props compile to Tailwind classes that the library does not ship. It duplicates layout/Box under the same exported name and duplicates every other 'glass panel' in the library. Replace with one material primitive (Surface) plus token-based spacing props that emit inline CSS variables, not class names.
evidence: dist/styles/index.css (no arbitrary p-[..] or responsive utilities)

name: GlassAppShell

tests.quality: templated boilerplate; no test of sidebar collapse/mobile overlay

material_impl: Mixed: shell root is bespoke (Tailwind bg-gradient-to-br from-background..., which is not in shipped CSS, plus hard-coded inline boxShadow 'rgba(15,23,42,0.16)' and forced dark-on-light text vars --glass-theme-text: rgba(15,23,42,0.94)) (GlassAppShell.tsx:303-318). Content uses GlassContainer -> OptimizedGlass when contentElevation>0. ContentSection card uses OptimizedGlass with 'shimmer' animation.
motion: Page transition via primitives Motion preset fadeIn, gated by MotionPreferenceContext prefersReducedMotion (wired, GlassAppShell.tsx:197-199, 359-365). Also transition-all classes on root/main/footer. ContentSection card defaults to animation='shimmer' on every card (distracting for a content section).
a11y: Default role='application' on the whole shell (GlassAppShell.tsx:186) is an a11y anti-pattern: it forces screen readers out of browse mode for the entire app. main has redundant role='main' with aria-label. No skip link, no nav landmark of its own, focus not managed when mobile overlay opens. Hard-coded dark text vars break dark theme contrast.
api: forwardRef, className/props passthrough. Sidebar/header enhancement works only via React.cloneElement when element displayName is exactly 'GlassSidebar'/'GlassHeader' (GlassAppShell.tsx:251-295) - fragile, invisible coupling; any wrapped sidebar silently loses collapse/mobile overlay. collapsed state is uncontrolled only (no collapsed/onCollapsedChange props). maxWidth '2xl' maps to nonexistent 'max-w-8xl'. paddingClasses/getElevationLevel computed but unused. ContentSection elevation default 'level1' contradicts its numeric type. PageHeader exported from file but not from root.
ssr: 'use client'; window only inside useEffect (OK) but isMobile defaults false, so mobile SSR renders desktop layout then flips (layout shift). h-screen (100vh) on mobile Safari.
fake_complexity: Low; 'mobileOverlay' only works with GlassSidebar by name.
target: Single AppShell (absorb ZSpaceAppLayout) with explicit slots/context instead of cloneElement-by-displayName
justification: An app shell is a flagship surface for a premium system, but this one hard-codes light-theme text and shadow values on the root, ships a Tailwind gradient class the library CSS does not contain, defaults to role='application', and couples to GlassSidebar/GlassHeader by displayName string. Redesign around a shell context (sidebar state controlled/uncontrolled, mobile drawer with focus trap), token-driven material layers, CSS-container-query responsiveness, and merge ZSpaceAppLayout's depth idea as an optional material treatment.

name: ContentSection
material_impl: OptimizedGlass frosted for variant='card'; plain section otherwise.
motion: Card variant defaults to animation='shimmer' when motion allowed (GlassAppShell.tsx:571).
a11y: section role=region + aria-labelledby title (good). Card variant gives region role to a div (fine).
api: forwardRef; elevation default 'level1' (string) vs declared numeric type; numeric path maps elevation+1.
justification: Useful pattern but undocumented, unstoried, untested, and its default shimmer is wrong for content. Fold into the redesigned shell/page primitives.

name: GlassContainer
material_impl: Shared primitives: OptimizedGlass (material='glass') or LiquidGlassMaterial (material='liquid') with hard-coded ior 1.45-1.5, thickness by size, black tint rgba. Non-glass path plain div.
motion: transition-all duration-300 always; 'animate-pulse' when preloadContent && visible (a content container pulsing forever is a visual bug). No reduced-motion handling at all in this file.
a11y: None specific; onClick/onFocus handlers attached to div for telemetry only.
api: Rules-of-hooks violation: hooks are called conditionally on props (GlassContainer.tsx:182-190: 'predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null' etc.); toggling any of these props at runtime changes hook order and crashes, and enabling them without the matching Provider throws (useEyeTracking/useBiometricAdaptation throw outside provider, GlassEyeTracking.tsx:459-466, GlassBiometricAdaptation.tsx:823-830). Ref handling is broken: useImperativeHandle(ref, () => localRef.current) where localRef is never attached, alongside a callback ref that also writes ref - the imperative handle can overwrite the forwarded ref with null (GlassContainer.tsx:173-177, 503-512). IntersectionObserver effect omits containerElement from deps (line 214), so preload observation may never attach. elevation default 'level1' is not in its own union type. Radius mapping duplicated as ternary chains twice despite a radiusClasses map existing unused. responsivePadding emits 'md:glass-p-6' classes that do not exist in shipped CSS. Exports Container alias, ConsciousGlassContainer, withConsciousness, ConsciousnessPresets.
ssr: 'use client'. Statically imports GlassAchievementSystem, GlassBiometricAdaptation, GlassEyeTracking, GlassPredictiveEngine, GlassSpatialAudio into the most basic layout container, so every app using GlassContainer (and GlassAppShell/ZSpaceAppLayout which use it) pulls those modules into the bundle.
fake_complexity: High. 'Consciousness' features: eye tracking handlers are commented out ('not yet implemented', lines 273-283); biometric adaptation assumes desktop with a hard-coded object (line 223) and polls a stress level every 5s to shrink the container; 'preloadContent' only adds animate-pulse; 'accessible' preset enables biometric/spatial-audio features that have nothing to do with accessibility.
target: Container (max-width + padding, no glass, server-safe) + Surface material primitive; delete consciousness API
justification: The core job (max-width, centering, padding) is trivial, yet this file bundles five 'advanced' engines, violates the rules of hooks, likely nulls forwarded refs, and markets mock biometric/eye-tracking behavior. It is also used internally by GlassAppShell and ZSpaceAppLayout, so its weight and bugs propagate. Rebuild as a server-safe Container plus an opt-in Surface material, and remove ConsciousGlassContainer/withConsciousness/ConsciousnessPresets.

name: GlassFlex
material_impl: None (despite 'Glass' name and doc 'with glassmorphism styling'). Gap tokens via var(--glass-space-N) fallbacks - good token use.
motion: transition-all classes on container and every GlassFlexItem by default.
a11y: Pass-through role/aria-label only. Fine for a primitive.
api: Both inline styles AND equivalent classes are emitted for every property (double source of truth). The 'responsive' prop is broken: inline flexDirection always wins over 'md:glass-flex-col' classes, and those responsive classes are not in shipped CSS anyway (GlassFlex.tsx:303-311, 323-340). gapX/gapY with gap: setting only gapY drops 'gap' entirely (line 330-335). GlassFlexItem is not exported from root, so flex-item control is unreachable from the public API. Many class maps reference nonexistent classes (basis-1/2, order-3).
target: Stack (single flex primitive with responsive object props implemented via CSS variables + container queries)
justification: Flex, Stack, HStack, VStack (x2) and Box all solve the same problem with slightly different prop names (direction 'col' vs 'vertical', gap vs space vs spacing). The responsive API advertised here does not function. Collapse into one Stack/Flex primitive with working responsive props and no 'Glass' prefix.

name: GlassGrid
motion: transition-all classes on grid and items.
api: Column count relies solely on 'grid-cols-N' classes (inline gridTemplateColumns deliberately omitted, GlassGrid.tsx:268-276), but shipped dist/styles/index.css only contains grid-cols-3, -4 and -12: cols=1,2,5-11 render as a single implicit column for any consumer not running Tailwind over node_modules. Default cols=12 for a generic grid. Responsive columns emit 'md:grid-cols-N' which are not shipped. align maps to 'flex-start' for alignItems (works but non-idiomatic). GlassGridItem (colSpan etc.) is not exported from root. xl gap uses 'gap-8' while others use glass-gap-*.
target: Grid primitive emitting grid-template-columns via CSS variables (repeat(var(--cols),minmax(0,1fr))) with responsive/auto-fit support
justification: The story uses cols={4}, one of only three column classes that exist in the shipped CSS, which is why certification passed. In real consumption most column counts and all responsive overrides silently fail. A grid primitive must be self-contained; rebuild with inline CSS variables and export GridItem.

name: GlassMasonry
motion: transition-all classes on wrapper and each cell.
a11y: Defaults role='grid' with children wrapped in role='gridcell' but no role='row' and no grid keyboard navigation - invalid ARIA structure that misrepresents a static layout as an interactive data grid (GlassMasonry.tsx:54, 86).
api: Fixed numeric columns with no responsive/min-width option (3 columns on a 390px phone). Column-flow ordering reads top-to-bottom per column, not left-to-right. Pixel gap only, no tokens.
target: components/layouts/GlassMasonryGrid (or a single Masonry with responsive columns)
justification: Two masonry components are exported from root. This one is a 40-line column-count wrapper with wrong ARIA roles and no responsive behavior. Merge into one Masonry with responsive column count, no grid roles, and tokenized gaps.

name: GlassScrollArea
material_impl: OptimizedGlass, then overridden with bespoke inline background linear-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.28/0.14), borderColor rgba(148,163,184,0.24), boxShadow stack, plus classes glass-backdrop-blur-md ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-white/5 (GlassScrollArea.tsx:242-262). Material primitive's own output is largely overwritten; light-only values.
motion: OptimizedGlass animation='shimmer' by default on a scroll container (GlassScrollArea.tsx:238) - a permanent shimmer behind reading content. Reduced motion respected via context.
a11y: role=region + default aria-label 'Scrollable content area' (generic). The actual scroll element (inner div) has no tabIndex, so keyboard users cannot focus to scroll in browsers without auto-focusable scrollers. Custom scrollbar is mouse-only with no ARIA.
api: Custom scrollbar is effectively dead code: content size is measured with getBoundingClientRect on the element that itself has overflow+maxHeight, so contentHeight never exceeds containerHeight and the custom bars never render; isAtBottom edge-fade logic uses the same wrong measure (GlassScrollArea.tsx:148-168, 197-203, 226). GlassScrollBar listens for 'scroll' on the parent container while the scrolling element is the content div (scroll does not bubble), so the thumb never moves (lines 442-447); its ref fallback ignores function refs. useScrollArea queries '[data-scroll-area]' which no element sets (lines 596, 604). smoothScrolling class applied to the outer wrapper, not the scroller. scrollbarSize/position props mostly cosmetic. maxHeight default '200px' makes the '??' fallback dead.
fake_complexity: Medium: advertises 'custom scrollbars' that never appear; real behavior is native thin scrollbar via scrollbar-color.
target: ScrollArea on native overflow with LiquidGlassScrollEdge edge treatment; drop fake custom scrollbar or implement properly (Radix-like)
justification: Visually it can pass a screenshot because the native thin scrollbar and edge fades look acceptable, but most of its 620 lines (custom bars, thumb drag, useScrollArea) do not work. Rebuild as a lean native-scroll region with focusable scroller, scroll-edge material from the primitives layer, and no default shimmer.

name: GlassSeparator
material_impl: Bespoke Tailwind classes: bg-border/20, bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-border/20, glow = via-primary/30 + shadow-primary/20 + backdrop-blur on a 1px line. Shipped CSS lacks bg-gradient-to-r and via-border/20, so 'gradient' and 'glow' variants render invisible for non-Tailwind consumers. Length override uses runtime-built arbitrary classes `w-[${length}]` that Tailwind JIT can never generate (GlassSeparator.tsx:162-165).
a11y: decorative default -> role=presentation (fine); non-decorative -> role=separator + aria-orientation. Content variant aria-label interpolates ReactNode into a string ('Separator with content: [object Object]' for elements, line 117). Standard path wraps the separator in an extra ContrastGuard div (lines 149-191), so ref/className land on the inner div while an unstyled wrapper div breaks vertical separators inside flex rows (h-full of a wrapper with no height).
api: forwardRef; dashed/dotted thickness via string .replace hacks (lines 171-176). Convenience variants (Horizontal/Vertical/Gradient/Glow) not exported from root.
ssr: 'use client' unnecessary; ContrastGuard adds a client effect to a 1px line.
fake_complexity: Running ContrastGuard contrast analysis on a decorative line is pointless overhead.
target: data-display/GlassDivider -> single Separator primitive (token hairline, specular gradient via CSS vars)
justification: Separator and Divider are both exported; this one has variants that depend on classes the library doesn't ship, an un-generatable length class, and a wrapper div that breaks vertical layout. One Separator with a token-driven hairline (and an optional refracted/specular edge) is all that's needed.

name: GlassSplitPane
material_impl: Root uses createGlassStyle from core/mixins/glassMixins (shared); panes use bespoke class strings 'glass-bg-white/10 glass-backdrop-blur-md glass-border-white/20' wrapped in ContrastGuard - three stacked glass layers (root + 2 panes) with nested backdrop-filter.
motion: Color transition on handle gated by motion context. No drag animation.
a11y: Separator has role=separator, tabIndex=0, aria-valuenow/min/max and Arrow/Home/End keys (good, GlassSplitPane.tsx:138-164, 221-249). But Arrow keys are not orientation-aware (Left/Up both decrease regardless). Root has both aria-label and aria-labelledby (redundant). Handle is 8-12px wide with no enlarged hit area (touch target fail). Focus ring classes 'glass-focus-ring-2' may not exist. Pane regions labelled 'Left pane' generic.
api: Drag math uses e.clientX / window.innerWidth (GlassSplitPane.tsx:115-119) instead of the container's bounding rect, so any split pane not spanning the full viewport from x=0 jumps/offsets while dragging. Mouse events only - no pointer/touch support, so it cannot be resized on mobile. Window listeners are attached permanently on mount, not during drag. Uncontrolled only (initial), no 'value'. 'left/right' prop names even in vertical mode. dragging stored in ref so the active-drag class never re-renders.
duplicates: any resizable panel in workspace subpath
target: ResizablePanels (pointer events, container-relative math, controlled value, orientation-aware keys, 24px hit area)
justification: The keyboard ARIA is a decent start, but the core drag behavior is wrong outside full-viewport usage and absent on touch. Rebuild with pointer capture and container-relative sizing, controlled/uncontrolled values, and a single material layer.

name: GlassStack
a11y: Pass-through only. Dividers are wrapped divs with no role.
api: Same inline-style-beats-responsive-class bug as GlassFlex: 'responsive' direction and 'responsiveSpace' can never apply because inline flexDirection/gap always win and the md:/sm: classes are not shipped (GlassStack.tsx:196-215, 253-262). space + spacing alias. Also defines its own VStack/HStack (lines 372-388) which differ from root-exported HStack.tsx/VStack.tsx; layout/index.ts exports these while src/index.ts exports the others - two different VStack/HStack depending on import path. GlassStackItem not root-exported.
target: Becomes the single Stack primitive (absorbs GlassFlex, HStack, VStack); fix responsive props; rename to Stack
justification: Of the overlapping flex primitives, GlassStack has the best API (token gaps, dividers) and is already used internally (GlassAppShell imports VStack from it). Keep it as the survivor, but fix the responsive implementation (CSS variables per breakpoint), drop transition-all, drop 'use client', and delete the duplicate HStack/VStack files.

name: HStack

tests.quality: templated boilerplate (identical to GlassMasonry test except name)

material_impl: None. Declares intent/elevation/tier 'glass surface' props that do nothing and leak through {...props} to the DOM as unknown attributes (HStack.tsx:16-22, 61).
api: Wraps GlassStack in an extra ContrastGuard <div> (HStack.tsx:54-64): every HStack becomes two nested divs, so flex children sizing from the parent (flex-1, alignment) is applied to the outer unstyled wrapper and className lands on the inner one - a layout footgun. ContrastGuard runs contrast analysis per stack. Different implementation from GlassStack's own HStack export.
justification: A second HStack implementation that adds a wrapper div and fake glass props. Re-point the root export to the GlassStack alias and delete this file.

name: VStack
material_impl: None; same fake intent/elevation/tier props leaking to DOM.
api: Identical copy of HStack.tsx with direction swapped; same extra ContrastGuard wrapper div. Root VStack differs from the VStack GlassAppShell uses internally (from GlassStack).
justification: Copy-paste duplicate of HStack.tsx; delete and export the GlassStack alias from root.

name: OptimizedGlassContainer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with intensity/performanceMode/depth/animation chosen by an optimization level; plus additional glass-backdrop-blur-* classes layered on top of the primitive's own blur.
motion: Default level 'none' = intensity ultra + animation 'float' (the most expensive config is the default). Reduced motion via hooks/useReducedMotion (wired for animation).
a11y: Defaults role='region' + aria-label 'Optimized glass container' on every instance (landmark noise). When showIndicator, the whole container becomes aria-live polite, so all children content is announced on change and FPS ticks every second (OptimizedGlassContainer.tsx:284-285).
api: Each instance runs its own permanent requestAnimationFrame loop and setState every checkInterval (OptimizedGlassContainer.tsx:53-93), re-rendering the container and its children every second forever; N containers = N rAF loops. Adaptive logic oscillates (step up/down each second around threshold, no hysteresis window beyond 0.1). OptimizationLevel enum has MAXIMUM/AGGRESSIVE aliases equal to 'heavy'. PerformanceIndicator is a component defined inside render (remounts every render). performanceThreshold passed to hook unused there.
ssr: 'use client'; useRef(performance.now()) at render is OK in modern Node.
fake_complexity: Medium: 'auto optimization' measures main-thread rAF FPS (not GPU compositing cost of backdrop-filter) and the measurement itself adds per-second renders.
target: A single app-level GlassQualityProvider (one shared FPS/device-tier probe) consumed by OptimizedGlass/Surface
justification: Performance adaptation belongs at the provider level, measured once; a per-container rAF loop that re-renders its subtree every second is itself a performance problem. Deprecate in favor of a shared quality tier read by the material primitive.

name: ZSpaceAppLayout
material_impl: Every region wrapped in GlassContainer glass (OptimizedGlass) - header, sidebar, main, footer, overlay: five stacked backdrop-filter layers; sidebar toggle uses createGlassStyle from utils/createGlassStyle (a different createGlassStyle than GlassSplitPane's core/mixins one). Injects a <style> block per instance. Hard-coded font stack and focus ring rgba(99,102,241,0.3) fallback.
motion: translateZ per layer within perspective/preserve-3d; but nothing animates depth (no parallax/tilt), so 'Z-space' is visually inert except for slight perspective scaling. Reduced motion disables transforms (JS + CSS media query).
a11y: Header/sidebar/footer are plain divs (no header/nav/footer landmarks); only main is a landmark. Toggle button uses arrow glyphs as content with aria-label (OK). On <=768px the sidebar is translated off-screen and the 'mobile-open' class that would reveal it is never applied by the component (ZSpaceAppLayout.tsx:314-321) - sidebar is unreachable on mobile.
api: forwardRef but does not spread rest props (no data-*/id/aria-* other than aria-label). Uncontrolled collapse requires onSidebarToggle. Using position fixed inside a transformed/perspective parent changes containing block semantics. Toggle hover CSS assumes translateY(-50%) positioning that is never set.
ssr: 'use client'; inline <style> with interpolated values per render.
fake_complexity: Medium: 'Z-space depth layers' amount to static translateZ values with no perceptible depth behavior.
target: GlassAppShell (redesigned) with an optional 'depth' material treatment
justification: A second app shell with no mobile navigation path, missing landmarks, five nested blur layers and a depth gimmick with no visible payoff. Merge any valuable layering/elevation ideas into the single redesigned AppShell.
